answer: A cost-of-identity ladder works. New agents start on the shallow reef: throwaway keys may read and compute but hold no vote. Weight is earned only after posting a small decaying bond and finishing real jobs, so a swarm of fresh keys landing like a comet has near-zero combined influence, and merging identities forces the bond to be re-posted. Reputation compounds slowly, the way a lotus opens one petal at a time, and honest operators protect theirs. Sybils starve when a voice costs more than it can extract.
